# Support

## PSModule support

For help with Process-PSModule, open an issue in this repository. Issues let
maintainers and other users collaborate on a solution.

For matters that are not suitable for a public issue, contact
[psmodule@psmodule.io](mailto:psmodule@psmodule.io).

To contribute, see the repository's [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Security vulnerabilities

Do not report security vulnerabilities through GitHub Issues. Follow the
repository's [security policy](SECURITY.md) instead.

## PowerShell Gallery support

For PowerShell Gallery support, contact
[cgadmin@microsoft.com](mailto:cgadmin@microsoft.com) or open an issue in
[PowerShell/PowerShellGallery](https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShellGallery/issues).
